title: Doubles I Can See
objective: A double is a whole made of two equal parts — a special case of the part/whole bonds already known.
newIdea: Doubles as bonds with equal parts, not a separately memorized category.

teaching.setup: Two equal groups of 6 counters each, side by side.
teaching.see: What do you notice about these two groups?
teaching.break: Confirm the two groups are exactly equal (pairing).
teaching.build: Combine them and name the whole: 6 + 6 = 12.
teaching.transform: 6 and 6 (an ordinary bond) named specially as double 6 — same value, a special-case name for a familiar form.

check.prompt: Re-split the 12 back into two equal groups to confirm they're still 6 and 6.

examples.transfer: 8 + 8, without objects — reasoned from the pattern.

mastery.evidence: Correctly identifies and states 2 doubles facts from equal object groups.
